hypothesis: Test whether gain+LS improves beyond LS alone; distinguish a combination contribution from generic smoothing benefit. Do not assume synergy.
control_reuse: Exact same source and study, frozen split, seed, batch, preprocessing, optimization, fullschedule, screening ceiling and selection rule. Controls already verified; no weights reused for initialization.
primary_metric: Clean held-out-speaker validation accuracy, AB minus B
support: Ordinary hard-label validation CE and curves, compare both best checkpoint and late-epoch behavior. Loss/gap alone insufficient.
decision_rule: If AB also exceeds B meaningfully and A comparison remains supportive, consider fixed-pair sensitivity. If B explains the gain or AB regresses, revise the complementarity claim; preserve all evidence. Extend matched arms only for explicit technical/learning evidence, not to obtain a favorable result.
estimated_compute: About5minutes plus startup from measured9.5second epochs
prior_art: Same established uniform label smoothing as B002; no novelty claim
